community_text:
[Rating: 5.5/10] This is a great game for the classroom as EVERY animal card has different facts about it. So much knowledge to be gained. As a game...it is just okay. I wouldn't play it with my game group but if I had a class I would bust it out there to learn more about animals.

[Rating: 8/10] I played this game at Spiel 2025. Surprisingly fun! Lots of interesting facts about animals, a fun mechanism where you fly to different continents, and the meeples are really beautiful to look at.

[Rating: 9/10] easygoing game for animal lovers and fans of multi mechanism gameplay alike. (for me at least) animal theme is charming, the real tension comes during final scoring, you have to keep track of your opponents’ cards.

[Rating: 9/10] Hi, Quick to play, simple to understand, and surprisingly strategic and it's also educational.

[Rating: 9/10] I met the game developers at the expo. The game is really good, but the artwork is an absolute masterpiece!
